(): {Keeper}'s sister sent a picture of the baby
My sister sent a picture of the baby! Shall we pin it up in the mess?

said: {keeper} pinned the baby's picture up in the mess
Look at her. Everyone keeps stopping to wave.
{keeper} kept the baby's picture by the bunk
I say goodnight to her every shift.
The baby's picture stayed in its envelope

(): The first tomato ripened in the dome garden
The first tomato's red! Share it round, or save it for seed?

yes: A slice each, thin as paper.

said: The colony shared the first tomato, a slice each
Thin as paper and the best thing on Mars.
{keeper} saved the first tomato for its seeds
Patience. Next year there'll be a hundred.
The first tomato split on the vine

(): {Explorer} wanted to test the new wheel
Come for a test drive on the new wheel? Just out to the crater rim and back.

said: {explorer} and you drove the rover out to the crater rim
Smooth as anything. I could drive to the ridge on that.
The rover's test drive was put off
Another day, then. It isn't going anywhere.

(): The street wanted another block party
Everyone's asking for another block party. Make it a summer thing?

said: The block party became a summer tradition on the street
First Saturday in June, every year. I'm making a sign.
The block party stayed a one-off
Fine. We'll always have that one night.
Talk of another block party died down

(): The neighbors baked a pie to say thank you
The neighbors baked us a pie for finding their dog! Eat it on the porch?

said: {keeper} and you ate the neighbors' pie on the porch
Cherry, still warm. The dog watched every bite.
The neighbors' pie went round the street
A sliver each, but everyone got one.
The pie went cold on the counter

(): The paper route paid out its tips
The paper route paid out tips! Split them, or put them in the street fund?

said: {explorer} split the paper route tips with you
Half each. I'm buying a new tape.
The paper route tips went into the street fund
The tips got spent on candy

(): {Keeper}'s egg hatched
The egg's hatched! Will you help me show the chick round the rookery?

said: You and {keeper} showed the new chick round the rookery
Everyone cooed. It fell asleep halfway round.
The new chick slept in the nest all day
Fast asleep. Tomorrow it meets everyone.

(): The crack in the causeway froze over
The crack's frozen over solid. Take the flags down, or leave them as a warning?

said: {explorer} took the flags down from the mended crack
Clear all the way across. Feels good.
The flags stayed up by the mended crack
They're halfway to the far floe now.

(): The fish vault was full to creaking
The vault's so full it's creaking. Have a feast, or keep it all for the dark?

said: The colony held a feast from the full fish vault
Fish on fish on fish. Nobody can move.
The full fish vault was kept for the dark
Sensible. The long nights will thank us.

(): The crew wanted to send a song to Earth
The crew wants to record a song for Earth. Sing it with me?

said: {explorer} and you recorded a song for Earth
Twelve minutes to get there. I hope they turn it up.
{explorer} recorded a song for Earth while you listened
You clapped in all the right places.
Nobody recorded the song for Earth

(): Crates blew off the pad in the dust devil
Two crates blew off the pad. Go out and find them, or write them off?

yes: Follow the tracks in the dust.

said: {explorer} and you found the crates the dust devil took
Half buried by the ridge, both of them. Lucky.
The crates the dust devil took were written off
Somebody on the ridge is getting a surprise.
The lost crates were buried by the dust

(): The colony ran low on air filters
We're low on air filters. Print a new batch, or ask the next shuttle?

said: {keeper} printed a new batch of air filters
Six new filters. The air's never been so quiet.
{keeper} ordered air filters on the next shuttle
The colony made do with old filters

(): The garage band got a gig at the diner
The band got a gig at the diner on Friday! Will you come and clap?

said: You cheered the band from the front row at the diner
You were the loudest one there. We heard you.
The band played the diner without you there
We were great. You'll have to trust me.
The band's gig at the diner fell through

(): The power came back on the block
The power's back! Keep a box of candles by the door, for next time?

said: {keeper} kept a box of candles by the door
Next time we'll be ready. And I'll still win at cards.
The candles went back in the drawer
The candles stayed wherever they were

(): {Keeper} saw a bike for sale
There's a ten-speed for sale at the garage. Help me fix it up?

said: {keeper} and you fixed up a ten-speed
Ten speeds! I'll never be late again.

(): A trader from the far floe brought seal oil
A trader from the far floe has seal oil. Swap some fish for it?

said: {keeper} swapped fish for seal oil from the far floe
Every lantern lit tonight. Look at the bridge!
The trader went back with the seal oil

(): The seal came back with a friend
The seal's back, and it's brought a friend! Share the hole, or cut a new one?

said: The colony shared the fishing hole with the seals
They took turns. Better manners than some of us.
{explorer} cut a new fishing hole away from the seals
Our own hole again. The seals waved.
The seals kept the fishing hole
Two seals, one hole, no fish.

(): Someone sang in the huddle
Someone started a song in the huddle last night. Shall we teach it to the chicks?

said: {keeper} taught the chicks the huddle song
They've only got the first line. They sing it all day.

yes: Some songs are for cold nights.

said: The huddle song was kept for cold nights
Next cold night, then. It's better in the dark.
Nobody remembered how the song went

(): {Explorer} had an idea for the solar panels
What if we rigged covers for the panels before the next storm? Old tarp, a few clips.

said: {explorer} and you rigged covers over the solar panels
Let the dust come. We're ready.
Brooms it is. My shoulders disagree.
The tarp's still in the store.

(): {Explorer} kept a peach stone
I kept a peach stone from the tin. Shall we try to grow it in the dome garden?

yes: A pot by the warm pipe.

said: {explorer} planted a peach stone in the dome garden
A peach tree on Mars. Give it ten years.
{explorer} kept the peach stone for luck
It's in my pocket. For luck.

(): The chicks found the snow wall
The chicks are sliding down the snow wall! Let them, or shoo them off before it breaks?

Squeals all afternoon. The wall's a bit shorter now.
{explorer} shooed the chicks off the snow wall
The chicks wore a groove in the wall
There's a slide in it now. Officially.

(): Herring was left over
There's herring left over. Smoke it for the dark, or give it to the skuas?

said: {keeper} smoked the leftover herring for the dark
The whole rookery smells of smoke. Lovely.
The leftover herring went to the skuas
Fat skuas leave eggs alone. That's the idea.

(): {Explorer} wanted a movie night at home
Let's do our own movie night on the garage wall! Borrow the school projector?

said: {explorer} showed a movie on the garage wall

(): {Keeper} thought about a spare suit
We should keep a spare suit by the airlock. Fix up the old training suit?

said: {keeper} and you fixed up a spare suit for the airlock
One spare, ready by the door. I sleep better already.

yes: Two suits go a long way.

said: Sharing it is. Mind the coffee smell.

(): The beans were ready
The beans are ready! Cook them tonight, or dry them for later?

yes: A real stew, with real beans.

said: {keeper} cooked the first beans into a stew

(): A seal fell asleep by the fishing hole

yes: It has to wake some time.

build: A seat for watching the seal

said: The colony shooed the seal from the fishing hole

(): The coldest night came
It's the coldest night yet. Huddle all together, or take turns on the outside?
